summary: Bring the new hires to Keldmouth, bind them to Lantern Pike, travel east, and reach the Harrowcross catastrophe

operations.title: The New Hires Arrive at Keldmouth
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The New Hires Arrive at Keldmouth

A mainland packet unloads five strangers into brine fog at the mouth of the River Keld. They identify one another while searching for the Lantern Pike lodge.

value.title: Five at the Dock

turns.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turns.text: Which one of you looks most like five competent hires from a distance?

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: The one carrying the contract tube.

turns.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turns.text: That is a fishing permit.

turns.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turns.text: Then I am carrying local color.

turns.speaker: char_671MWM7KTP4DCVVP8EP6SFRJVP
turns.text: Brother Garran Holt. Hearth and Road. I mend people before contracts, when allowed.

turns.speaker: char_0NQKTG3NQZFSVFKXS901NJD82E
turns.text: Sylvi Ashdown. The gulls will not land on the east pilings.

turns.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turns.text: Veyra Kest. Those pilings are capped with amber nails.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: Rhea Marrow. We find the guild before we study the dock.

turns.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turns.text: Pip Fenlock. I study exits while walking toward orders.

turns.speaker: char_0NQKTG3NQZFSVFKXS901NJD82E
turns.text: Then study the forest side. Nothing living is watching the city from there.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Five at the Dock

The party's first conversation establishes voice, competence, and the Frontier's unnatural animal silence.

The turn list is canonical verbatim provenance. Character recollections are stored separately and may disagree.

frontmatter.title: The Mouth of the Keld

observations.text: Brine fog hides the upper city while amber-capped pilings glow beneath the quay water.
Gulls crowd ordinary timber but refuse every piling capped with amber.
The amber nail heads answer Veyra's presence with a pressure behind her teeth.

author_constraints: The party does not yet know amber is local currency or that it causes manifestations.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# The Mouth of the Keld

Five strangers meet at the river mouth and begin forming a company before any of them has seen a guild badge.

recollection.summary: The other four are undisciplined but observant; Sylvi notices the wrong things are absent and Veyra notices the wrong things are magical.
recollection.interpretation: They may be usable as a unit if she gives them clear work.

recollection.summary: Rhea assumes command, Garran offers help without bargaining, Veyra hears the amber nails, and Pip jokes when uncertain.
recollection.interpretation: The Frontier begins where animals choose not to stand.

recollection.summary: Rhea organizes the group before anyone asks, while Sylvi and Veyra independently notice that the dock is wrong.
recollection.interpretation: The company is already listening to different kinds of danger.

recollection.summary: The party includes a soldier, a tracker, a priest, and a locksmith; the dock amber responds faintly to magic or bloodline.
recollection.interpretation: Amber is active material, whatever the locals call it.

recollection.summary: Rhea takes the invisible job of deciding where they go, and everyone reveals more by correcting him than by introducing themselves.
recollection.interpretation: The easiest way into the group is to let Rhea think she has organized him.

operations.title: The Lantern Pike Hires the Five
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Lantern Pike Hires the Five

The five sign one contract, receive badges, and accept emergency reassignment language they do not yet understand.

value.title: New Hires at Lantern Pike

turns.speaker: char_37D4GED06VHV5Q82C2GHTKFYCX
turns.text: The Lantern Pike does not hire heroes. It hires people who return with the caravan, the witness, or an honest account of why neither returned.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: What is the first assignment?

turns.speaker: char_37D4GED06VHV5Q82C2GHTKFYCX
turns.text: Eastroad caravan. Twelve wagons. Keldmouth to the farming and amber settlements. You answer to Maela Brigg until emergency reassignment.

turns.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turns.text: How broad is emergency?

turns.speaker: char_6WSXTMCRGJDB5AAS6JHBPXJF2Y
turns.text: Broader than the road and narrower than refusing it.

turns.speaker: char_671MWM7KTP4DCVVP8EP6SFRJVP
turns.text: Monster categories?

turns.speaker: char_37D4GED06VHV5Q82C2GHTKFYCX
turns.text: Beast, revenant, witch-work, giant-kind, and unclassified frontier predator.

turns.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turns.text: Unclassified by whom?

turns.speaker: char_37D4GED06VHV5Q82C2GHTKFYCX
turns.text: By whoever survived long enough to file.

turns.speaker: char_0NQKTG3NQZFSVFKXS901NJD82E
turns.text: What does the guild know east of Harrowcross?

turns.speaker: char_37D4GED06VHV5Q82C2GHTKFYCX
turns.text: Enough to hire you and not enough to send you alone.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: Five names. One company. We sign together.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# New Hires at Lantern Pike

Halric defines the guild's terms narrowly enough to sound honest and broadly enough to abandon the party later.

The turn list is canonical verbatim provenance. Character recollections are stored separately and may disagree.

frontmatter.title: Lantern Pike Induction

observations.text: Amber in Halric's cane brightens when the hearth spits and goes dull when he closes his hand around it.
The emergency reassignment clause is written in larger script than the pay rate.
The five badges are numbered consecutively, as if the guild already decided they are one unit.

author_constraints: The phrase unclassified frontier predator is meaningful but unexplained to the party.

value.bodyMarkdown:

operations.title: The Party Is Paid in Amber
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Party Is Paid in Amber

Nara issues the first wages as drilled amber discs and offers no explanation beyond their purchasing power.

value.title: Amber Wages

turns.speaker: char_6WSXTMCRGJDB5AAS6JHBPXJF2Y
turns.text: One drilled disc each now, four after Harrowcross, plus board on caravan days.

turns.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turns.text: This is amber.

turns.speaker: char_6WSXTMCRGJDB5AAS6JHBPXJF2Y
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turns.text: I was promised money.

turns.speaker: char_6WSXTMCRGJDB5AAS6JHBPXJF2Y
turns.text: You were promised local wages.

turns.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turns.text: Why the charcoal powder in the pouch?

turns.speaker: char_6WSXTMCRGJDB5AAS6JHBPXJF2Y
turns.text: Keeps the discs from sweating in heat.

turns.speaker: char_0NQKTG3NQZFSVFKXS901NJD82E
turns.text: Amber sweats?

turns.speaker: char_6WSXTMCRGJDB5AAS6JHBPXJF2Y
turns.text: Everything sweats here eventually.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: What buys food east of the gate?

turns.speaker: char_6WSXTMCRGJDB5AAS6JHBPXJF2Y
turns.text: Amber. Salt. Iron. Promises, once per customer.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Amber Wages

The party learns that amber is both pay and a subject locals have practiced not explaining.

The turn list is canonical verbatim provenance. Character recollections are stored separately and may disagree.

frontmatter.title: Amber at the Pay Table

observations.text: Each amber disc holds a moving gold sheen that remains level when the disc tilts.
The opened wage pouch creates a pressure in Veyra's teeth like the amber-capped dock pilings, only stronger.
The amber has no scent, but the clerk's pulse changes when Sylvi lifts a disc near the hearth brazier.

author_constraints: No party member yet knows why amber is damped with charcoal.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Amber at the Pay Table

The Frontier's currency arrives without a lesson, and the lack of explanation becomes its own warning.

frontmatter.title: Learn What Counts as Pay

transitions.note: The party receives and can spend amber wages.

operations.title: The Eastroad Caravan Departs
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Eastroad Caravan Departs

Maela leads twelve wagons through Keldmouth's east gate and assigns the new company to rotate between lead, flank, and rear guard.

operations.title: A Fox-Shaped Glimmer Crosses the Road
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# A Fox-Shaped Glimmer Crosses the Road

A transparent fox-shaped figure runs from one milestone into another without crossing the open ground between them. It leaves no tracks, and the amber wage pouch is briefly warm.

frontmatter.title: Eastroad Caravan

observations.text: The road runs between black spruce and abrupt views of a cold iron sea.
Deer tracks approach the road repeatedly and turn away before crossing the wagon ruts.
A transparent fox-shape enters one stone milestone and exits the next without touching the road between them.
The amber wage pouch warms for three breaths while the fox-shape is visible.

author_constraints: The apparition is a weak wretch manifestation but the party has no name for it.
Maela does not see the fox clearly and dismisses the report.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Eastroad Caravan

The caravan travels east through sleet. The first manifestation is subtle enough to remain deniable.

frontmatter.title: Sylvi knows the fox-shape left no tracks

claim.statement: The transparent fox-shape crossed between milestones without leaving tracks in sleet or mud.
claim.subject: event_5NPPJMVJKV8A31D2YFTFD70TVG

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Sylvi knows the fox-shape left no tracks

The transparent fox-shape crossed between milestones without leaving tracks in sleet or mud.

This is a subjective proposition held by the named knower, not a replacement for canonical event or conversation provenance.

claim.statement: The party's amber wages became warm during the fox-shaped apparition.
claim.subject: obj_485CVZ39Y0QFJWRDZ53C18BQ9T

value.title: Saltmere Campfire

turns.speaker: char_4YCQAG8HHJ83ZY2P3RN6KY0AXD
turns.text: First rule east of Keldmouth: wagons make a circle before anyone makes tea.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: Second rule?

turns.speaker: char_4YCQAG8HHJ83ZY2P3RN6KY0AXD
turns.text: If the woods go quiet, count people before horses.

turns.speaker: char_0NQKTG3NQZFSVFKXS901NJD82E
turns.text: They have been quiet since the gate.

turns.speaker: char_4YCQAG8HHJ83ZY2P3RN6KY0AXD
turns.text: Then count us continuously and call it professionalism.

turns.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turns.text: The wage amber warmed when the fox appeared.

turns.speaker: char_4YCQAG8HHJ83ZY2P3RN6KY0AXD
turns.text: Amber warms in coats, sunlight, fever, kitchens, arguments, and stories told by new hires.

turns.speaker: char_671MWM7KTP4DCVVP8EP6SFRJVP
turns.text: That is an impressive number of explanations for a stone.

turns.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turns.text: It is not a stone. Nara was very clear that it is money.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: Maela. If the thing returns, do we fight it?

turns.speaker: char_4YCQAG8HHJ83ZY2P3RN6KY0AXD
turns.text: If it can bite a horse, yes. If it can only frighten scholars, keep the caravan moving.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Saltmere Campfire

The party raises the road apparition with Maela and learns how aggressively experienced travelers normalize frontier warnings.

The turn list is canonical verbatim provenance. Character recollections are stored separately and may disagree.

frontmatter.title: Saltmere Campfire

observations.text: No fox, raven, or mouse approaches the caravan scraps despite the long dusk.
The wage discs are cold again before Maela finishes listing ordinary reasons they might have warmed.
Maela places the new company on the side of the wagon circle nearest the forest rather than the sea.

author_constraints: Maela knows amber incidents are treated as road folklore, not the Blackroot Compact.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Saltmere Campfire

At the first road camp, the party discovers that experienced Frontier travelers survive partly by refusing to connect their observations.

recollection.summary: Maela has rules for unnatural quiet but refuses to connect amber warmth to the fox-shaped apparition.
recollection.interpretation: The caravan master knows enough to manage risk and not enough—or not willingly enough—to explain it.

recollection.summary: Maela produced many ordinary explanations for warm amber without testing any of them.
recollection.interpretation: The Frontier has social defenses against asking what amber does.

recollection.summary: The woods have been quiet since Keldmouth and Maela treats that as something to count around rather than investigate.
recollection.interpretation: The road's animal absence is established danger, not Sylvi's private unease.

value.title: The Last Watch

turns.speaker: char_6RM0PWHAC6EJNJFPHNW1WAZ51G
turns.text: Bar the east door. The amber chest is humming again.

turns.speaker: char_5TTB85PHNSS5YBVVXG9F473WVN
turns.text: It is a box, Corporal. Boxes do not hum.

turns.speaker: char_7DS75TG6WFK6ZD1T9GCBJRMK1T
turns.text: This one does.

turns.speaker: char_5BPBB10TM9S8M5AB4T6B6CNPZ6
turns.text: Something is scratching under the floor.

turns.speaker: char_6RM0PWHAC6EJNJFPHNW1WAZ51G
turns.text: Nobody opens the door. Bran, move the chest away from the bunks.

turns.speaker: char_5TTB85PHNSS5YBVVXG9F473WVN
turns.text: Bottle broke. Give me a cloth.

turns.speaker: char_7DS75TG6WFK6ZD1T9GCBJRMK1T
turns.text: Your blood is running toward the chest.

turns.speaker: char_5BPBB10TM9S8M5AB4T6B6CNPZ6
turns.text: Asha, there is a deer in the wall.

turns.speaker: char_6RM0PWHAC6EJNJFPHNW1WAZ51G
turns.text: Spear line. Do not look at the floor.

turns.speaker: char_5BPBB10TM9S8M5AB4T6B6CNPZ6
turns.text: It has Bran's teeth.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# The Last Watch

The canonical final words of the Harrowcross watch. Only Kellan survives to remember them.

The turn list is canonical verbatim provenance. Character recollections are stored separately and may disagree.

operations.title: The Harrowcross Watch Hears the Amber Chest
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Harrowcross Watch Hears the Amber Chest

The barred watch notices the amber payment chest humming and scratching beneath the floor before Bran cuts his palm on a bottle.

operations.title: The Harrowcross Guard Detail Is Torn Apart
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Harrowcross Guard Detail Is Torn Apart

Blood reaches the cracked amber chest. Antlered and wolf-like wretches emerge through floor and walls, repeating the guards' voices while killing three of them. Kellan survives beneath a collapsed bunk.

operations.title: The Caravan Reaches Harrowcross
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Caravan Reaches Harrowcross

The caravan enters a town with mourning cord around the gate and no watch detail standing inspection.

value.title: The Sergeant's Account

turns.speaker: char_1F7JEGBD02MVY0J8M9X0967T5T
turns.text: The east watch was torn apart overnight.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: By what?

turns.speaker: char_1F7JEGBD02MVY0J8M9X0967T5T
turns.text: If I knew, I would have named it before I asked a caravan for hunters.

turns.speaker: char_4YCQAG8HHJ83ZY2P3RN6KY0AXD
turns.text: My bond carries freight east. It does not replace village watchmen.

turns.speaker: char_2YA8FQRX5Q0PRKSETNQZ4EEDKZ
turns.text: Harrowcross has paid the Lantern Pike through winter. The badges standing here are what arrived.

turns.speaker: char_7DS75TG6WFK6ZD1T9GCBJRMK1T
turns.text: The door never opened.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# The Sergeant's Account

Edrik opens his report while Maela and Hessa argue over who inherits responsibility for the undefended town.

The turn list is canonical verbatim provenance. Character recollections are stored separately and may disagree.

frontmatter.title: Harrowcross at Dusk

observations.text: Black mourning cord is tied around the east gate posts and every watch bell has been wrapped in cloth.
No armed guard meets the caravan, although the gate stands open.
Kellan's bandaged hands tremble hardest when Maela's wagon amber passes near him.
Maela counts wagons twice while Edrik speaks and never looks toward the barracks.

author_constraints: The full massacre mechanism remains unknown to the party.
The conversation is intentionally active at the act boundary so later turns and recollections can be appended through wedl.

value.bodyMarkdown:

At the crossroads town, the caravan meets a catastrophe large enough to activate the guild contract's emergency clause.
